scripts.build: npm run clean && vite build && vite build --config vite.editor.config.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const src='resources/css/editor.css'; const dest='dist/css/editor.css'; fs.mkdirSync('dist/css',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(src,dest)"
scripts.check-versions: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')); const main=fs.readFileSync('emje-motion.php','utf8'); const m=main.match(/EMJE_MOTION_VERSION',\s*'([^']+)'/); const v=m?m[1]:'unknown'; console.log('package.json:'+pkg.version+' plugin:'+v); if(pkg.version!==v){console.error('Version drift!');process.exit(1)}"
